description: Key metrics for a company, newest period first. Unknown query parameters are refused. Without metric, the five headline metrics; a bank's income lines (total_interest_income, net_interest_income, noninterest_income, net_revenue) come only when named. For a bank, net_revenue is the usual revenue measure. Free with no sign-in: AAPL, MSFT, JPM, KO, XOM, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, TSLA, LLY. Costs 1 credit. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess). A figure can change or disappear when a later filing arrives; figures are not versioned. Read `adjustments` for extractor decisions beyond copying one filed figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.

metric.description: One metric key. Bank lines are served for banks and lenders only.
